title: The security-scan check fails non-zero on findings at or above the project severity threshold
asA: operator whose project enables the elicited security-scan check
iWant: a security-scan gate whose exit code is driven by the project-configured severity threshold, not a build-in choice
soThat: the gate applies across risk postures without changing the tool or the report shape

acceptanceCriteria.description: When `checkSet.securityScan` is true, the gate-runner runs the project-realised security-scan runner. A non-zero exit code (indicating one or more findings at or above the project-configured severity threshold) flips the gate outcome to `failed`. Findings below the threshold are recorded in the per-gate report without flipping the exit code. The per-gate report at `.rcf/reports/ci/security.json` carries `checkKind: "securityScan"`. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with `checkSet.securityScan: true` and a realised security-scan runner configured with the project's severity threshold
acceptanceCriteria.when: a CI workflow invokes the gate-runner
acceptanceCriteria.then: a report file at `.rcf/reports/ci/security.json` is written with `checkKind: "securityScan"`, and the gate outcome tracks the runner exit code

acceptanceCriteria.description: The security-scan gate reads the project severity threshold and fails at or above it; a finding one severity level below the threshold does not fail the gate but is written to the per-gate report so the operator sees the near-miss. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent supplies the project's severity threshold and the scanner's finding shape; the AC substitutes them for the illustrative threshold=high paired with a medium finding and a high finding.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a security scanner configured with threshold=high and a run that yields a medium finding and a high finding
acceptanceCriteria.then: the per-gate report writes verdict=failed on the high finding; the medium finding appears under `belowThreshold[]` with severity=medium; the report is written even when the gate fails

description: Section 7a floor: two ACs. Guide and TAC-701 name no security-scan-specific failure paths beyond runner-missing (AC-6102-3), gate-aggregation gaps (AC-6108-1), and the severity-threshold path bound by AC-6120-2; this story owns the security-scan-specific gate mechanics (per-gate report at .rcf/reports/ci/security.json with belowThreshold[] carrying near-misses).
